liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China>Rider is called the best of the 1974-style versions, with Jerry crackling; China>Rider is ranked among the top of the era, and best of 1974 [11][17]
- **Deal** (1 review): Deal is bright and snappy, and it energizes the Jack Straw that follows [9]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet Begonias is played uptempo, faster than most versions [9]
- **Big River** (1 review): Reviewer names this Big River as a personal all-time favorite [17]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Truckin' is called immense, among the best ever played [16]
- **Jam** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the second-set jam as a reason to stream the show [11]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Let it Grow is short for the period but very hot [16]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): One More Saturday Night is jumpy and bouncing, tighter than most performances [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-25.111432.mtx.sirmick.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 28 songs; 165 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1974-05-25.sbd.jmiller.205.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: David Hollister reports problems on the USB track [3]
- **gd74-05-25.sbd.moog.2635.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 4.14/5 by 28 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers their own audience tape to this soundboard, which they call the Latvala special [17]
- **gd1974-05-25.aud.gems.111301.flac16**: audience recording; 27 songs; 162 min; rated 4.92/5 by 12 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls the afternoon sun making it 100 degrees [10]
- Reviewer says Maria Muldaur and the Great American String Band, with Jerry, opened, not the New Riders (who played in 1973) [12]
- Reviewer recalls a purple weather balloon releasing purple gas over the crowd [13]
- Reviewer remembers sheriff's deputies on horseback at the show [13]
- Reviewer recalls speaker stacks decorated with smiling clown faces in the wind [13]
- Other acts listed on the bill: Maria Muldar, Great American String Band, and Elvin Bishop [1]
- Reviewer counts this as one of three great shows at the UCSB stadium [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-25.111432.mtx.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: Matrix: 60%sbd/40% aud; Sources: Master Soundboard Reel > Dick Latvala's Cassette > DAT > mastered to CD-R on an HHB CDR-850 > .shn (shnid 2635) Originally… [1]. Also: Matrix mix labeled sirmick, in FLAC 16-bit format, from the sbeok-tagged sources [1]
- **gd1974-05-25.sbd.jmiller.205.sbeok.shnf**: source: MSR > C > DAT > CDR > SHN [3]. Also: Soundboard transfer labeled jmiller, in shn format [3]
- **gd74-05-25.sbd.moog.2635.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]
- **gd1974-05-25.aud.gems.111301.flac16**: taped by Jeremy Witt; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Recording Info: FOB Audience Recording by Jeremy Witt Preserved in posterity for 36 years by Jay Abrams (jra-sm) Recording Equipment: Sony TC-152, Sony Mics,… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by www.collectorsweekly.com: [1974 Grateful Dead & Maria Muldaur concert handbill from UC Santa Barbara Campus Stadium | Collectors Weekly](https://www.collectorsweekly.com/stories/74672-1974-grateful-dead-and-maria-muldaur-conce) [23]
- Poster by tela.sugarmegs.org: [Sugarmegs Audio Setlist](https://tela.sugarmegs.org/_asxtela/asxcards/gd1974-05-25CampusStadiumSantaBarbaraCA.html) [24]
- Poster by www.collectorsweekly.com: [1974 Grateful Dead & Maria Muldaur concert handbill from UC Santa Barbara Campus Stadium | Collectors Weekly](https://www.collectorsweekly.com/stories/74672-1974-grateful-dead-and-maria-muldaur-conce) [25]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Campus Stadium - May 25, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/may-25-1974) [26]
- Poster by www.collectorsweekly.com: [1974 Grateful Dead & Maria Muldaur concert handbill from UC Santa Barbara Campus Stadium | Collectors Weekly](https://www.collectorsweekly.com/stories/74672-1974-grateful-dead-and-maria-muldaur-conce) [27]
- Poster by Steve Caraway Grateful Dead: [1974-05-25 Campus Stadium, UC Santa Barbara, Goleta, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1974-05-25-campus-stadium-uc-santa-barbara-goleta-ca-usa/) [28]
- Photo by David Newman (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead Audience at Campus Stadium, UC Santa Barbara May 25, 1974](https://www.flickr.com/photos/49503165614@N01/2344235125/) [29]
